blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
A warehouse morning is pure routine. It is the same sequence every day: same people, same times. Today we use the Present Simple to describe those daily actions.

Emily starts work at six. Harry prints the route sheets. The team loads the first truck by seven. They check every pallet before it goes.

Once the pattern is clear, reporting a morning becomes easy. A good routine prevents mistakes. Clarity starts at 6 am, and morning habits shape the whole shift.

items.q: What time does Emily start work?
items.why: "Emily starts work at six."

items.q: What does Harry do?
items.why: "Harry prints the route sheets."

items.q: When does the team load the first truck?
items.why: "The team loads the first truck by seven."

items.q: The text suggests that a good routine…
items.why: Inferência: "A good routine prevents mistakes" — a rotina ajuda a evitar erros.

items.q: The team checks every pallet before it goes. This suggests they want the work to be…
items.why: Inferência: verificar cada palete antes de sair mostra cuidado para acertar.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Emily descrever a manhã dela no armazém. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, I am Emily. Let me tell you about my morning at the warehouse.

I start work at six. First, I check the trucks. I look at the tyres and the doors. Then I open the big gate for the drivers. The morning air is cold, but I like it.

Harry arrives at half past six. He prints the route sheets for the day. He is very fast. After that, the team prepares the first truck. We load the boxes and we check every pallet.

At seven o'clock, the first truck is ready. The driver takes the sheets and goes. I say good morning to everyone. I like my job because the routine is clear. Same people, same times, every day.

A good morning is a calm morning. When I check everything, we make no mistakes. That is why I always start early.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What does Emily check first?
items.why: "First, I check the trucks."

items.q: What time does Harry arrive?
items.why: "Harry arrives at half past six."

items.q: What is ready at seven o'clock?
items.why: "At seven o'clock, the first truck is ready."

items.q: Why does Emily like her job?
items.why: "I like my job because the routine is clear."

items.q: Emily says she always starts early. This suggests that starting early helps her to…
items.why: Inferência: "When I check everything, we make no mistakes" — começar cedo a deixa tranquila e sem erros.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I start work at six." Start means…
items.why: Start = começar.

items.q: "I check the trucks every morning." Check means…
items.why: Check = verificar, olhar com atenção.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I ___ the big gate for the drivers."
items.why: Open = abrir — ela abre o portão para os motoristas.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Harry and the drivers ___ at half past six."
items.why: Arrive = chegar.

items.q: "The team prepares the first truck." Prepare means…
items.why: Prepare = preparar, deixar pronto.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho do dia a dia. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Every day I show up at six." Show up means to…
items.why: Show up = aparecer, chegar ao trabalho.

items.q: "The team sets up the trucks before seven." Set up means to…
items.why: Set up = preparar, deixar pronto.

items.q: "We load up the boxes fast." Load up means to…
items.why: Load up = carregar, colocar as coisas dentro.

items.q: "I check on the drivers in the morning." Check on means to…
items.why: Check on = dar uma olhada, ver se está tudo bem.

items.q: "At seven, the driver takes off." Take off means to…
items.why: Take off = partir, ir embora.
